title: Sacred Beast: Nerakyss, the Kraken
description: One of the two Sacred Beasts that hold the seal. Drag Nerakyss from the deep and end it together.
lore: Holy things, great and old, and they have done no wrong. Yet the seal in them has thinned, and the hunger waits behind it. Take what must be taken.

objectives.description: Defeat Nerakyss, the Kraken (counts for the whole group)
